Hey Beekeepers!
Thanks to everyone for sending in their reports off the back of the last announcement - I've spent the last few weeks working through bugs old and new, as well as adding in some small QoL tweaks.

As part of 4.5.0, I was finally able to update the engine, as GameMaker's last LTS version was back in 2022! Their newest update only came out in May this year, so there's a good few years of updates that broke some stuff. I also spent a lot of time doing performance tweaks + changes, plus used a different type of export that was broken before that is supposed to be FasterTM.

Because of all of these 'major' changes from a technical perspective, I thought it'd be better to do this update as a preview first so people can opt-in! I've taken a lot of time checking through all of the game, as well as testing with a bunch of different players' saves and multiplayer gameplay but I would appreciate if anyone has the time to go and check out 4.5.0 and make sure everything seems okay with their world / PC!

If you're interested in trying out the 4.5.0 preview, first MAKE A COPY OF YOUR SAVE FILES - just in case anything happens! On Windows your save files are in "%localappdata%/APICO", MacOS it's in Application Support.
Go to Steam, click on APICO, click the settings 'cog' button
Go to "Properties"
Go to "Game Versions & Betas"
Click the "preview_patch" branch

Close the settings popup: Steam will begin downloading the 4.5.0 update and then you can try it out! You can read the full patch notes of what's changed and what's been fixed below. Nothing major has been added, APICO is finished after all (sorry!), but there were some small QoL that were quick to add that I felt was worth doing so I snuck them in also :): If you run into any issues, please let me know! Either using the form in-game, the forums here on Steam, or just email me - ell@tngineers.com.: While I continue testing 4.5.0 (and fixing any stuff that might come up from the preview players!) I'll be preparing the console submissions for Switch/PS/Xbox, which will still be a little while off yet. When the PC 4.5.0 seems stable enough I'll make it live and release non-steam versions (itch / amazon / epic etc) too, which hopefully won't be too far away!: Thanks again to all of you, and appreciate your patience with this one <3: ~ Ell

Hey Beekeepers,
This is a maintenance patch for APICO to keep those pesky bees out of the cogs!
Mostly bug fixes and some multiplayer tweaks, thanks to everyone who's been reporting issues <3
A few MacOS players have reported crashes when trying to use mods - currently this issue is still present in this build.
These crashes are due to an issue with GameMaker and has been reported to them directly, so until they fix it MacOS players will not be able to run mods.
I've tried to find some temporary workarounds but unfortunately there isn't anything I can do about it my side - I'll keep you all posted and I'm very sorry for any inconvenience <3
~ Ell

Hey Beekeepers!
Exciting news today, I can reveal that the 3rd and final free content update for APICO, "Hive Of Industry", will be dropping on PC+Switch on May 20th, aka International Bee Day, aka APICO's birthday!

This update will bring new honeycore mechanics, automation machines, cute pets, seasonal events, a butt-load of decoration, new music, more bees, more butts, and a whole lot of QoL bits and bobs you've all been after - check out the trailer below for a preview:

If you still want to know more, you can check out the patch notes for the upcoming content early over on the wiki!. It's a big one (and thats without all the bug fixes!) but should make for a wonderful farewell for us all.
Keep an eye out over the next few weeks for a few events, including a livestream / AMA type thing, plus the new soundtrack in all it's glory <3
~ Ell
